purpose: Resolve numerical BEM mesh sensitivity and quantify the value of available subject calibration within the richer persistent-state model

mesh.caps: nominal only; matched source states and source normals

calibration.scope: Full test observations and full known-label calibration, same fixed state per subject; exact finite-bank prior reference separately from development-prototype operational predictions

interpretation: Separate supplementary model/numerical checks; no changes to main targets, amplitudes, noise, policies or outcomes. Mesh comparison is a sensitivity check, not a convergence guarantee. Calibration reference knows the finite test-state law and does not certify real EEG calibration benefit.
